title: FuRyu Announces Anomalith Survival Horror Game
content: FuRyu revealed during the Six One Indie showcase on Friday it will publish ANOMALITH , an anomaly horror survival action game. The company will release the game for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam on October 29. Winning Entertainment Group (formerly Natsume Atari) is developing the game.
author: ANN

title: Kamentotsu's The Creepy and Freaky Manga Ends
content: Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ platform announced in the 49th chapter of Kamentotsu 's The Creepy and Freaky ( Kowaiya-san ) manga on Wednesday that the series will end in the next chapter on May 27.
author: ANN

title: Netflix’s KPop Demon Hunters Successor Hits New Milestone
content: KPop Demon Hunters has earned its place as the biggest Netflix animated movie of all time, and for good reason. The titanic Sony Pictures Animation has been streamed for hundreds of hours, but its rule as the top-performing film for the streaming service might be coming to an end.
author: ComicBook

title: Titan Manga Reveals Cover Spreads for The Five Star Stories Manga's English Release
content: Titan Manga revealed the cover art and full jacket spreads on Thursday for it and Newtype magazine's English release of Mamoru Nagano 's The Five Star Stories manga. Titan Manga and Newtype will release the first volume on September 1 (the volume was previously slated for July 7).
author: ANN

title: One Piece Director Shares Spicy Take on Black Clover Finale
content: In the shonen world, some stories have become legendary, with the tales of Asta and Monkey D. Luffy easily fitting the bill. With Black Clover bringing its story to an end earlier this year, one of the biggest anime directors working today has taken the chance to share their thoughts on the grand finale.
author: ComicBook

title: Sword Art Online's Echoes of Aincrad Game's Trailer Previews Abilities, Partners, Weapons
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment America began streaming on Thursday a system trailer for Echoes of Aincrad , the new action RPG based on Reki Kawahara 's Sword Art Online franchise . The video previews character abilities, partners, and weapons.
author: ANN

title: Cartoon Network Animator Reveals The Reboot That Never Was
content: Revivals are a big ticket item for Cartoon Network these days, as the likes of Regular Show: The Lost Tapes and Adventure Time: Side Quests are both bringing back major animated franchises.
author: ComicBook

title: SkySet Entertainment to Stream, Produce English Dub for Go Forward Anime Series
content: Licensing and dubbing studio SkySet Entertainment announced on Thursday it will stream the Go Forward ( Massugu ni Ikō ) television anime and the sequel series Massugu ni Ikō: Melon Pan-hen , and will produce an English dub in late summer 2026.
author: ANN

title: My Hero Academia/Berserk Actor, Takahiro Fujiwara, Dead at 43
content: When it comes to the anime industry, there are many creative forces that help some of the biggest franchises come to life. Animators, directors, and voice actors all unite to help bring to life major stories that resonate long after their stories are complete.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix’s Avatar: The Last Airbender Season 2 Trailer Gives Best Look at New Episodes Yet
content: Avatar: The Last Airbender is readying to make its comeback to Netflix with a new season of the live-action series, and fans have gotten the best look at the new Season 2 episodes yet with a cool trailer showing it all off.
author: ComicBook
